title: 第一卷 第21章 杀手锏第一卷 第22章 一夜暴富
slug: 师叔你的法宝太不正经了
content_zh:
;;
叶紫樱和禹青阳也是忍不住后退一步。
李寒舟竟然会大天象诀？
他和云荒的那些人是什么关系？
李寒舟之前得到了《大天象诀》之后，也是好奇，这功法到底是什么样的，于是这几天闲来无事的时候，也翻了翻，倒是没想到自己竟然真的能施展出来。
大天象诀修炼到极致，可以操控天象之力。
风雨雷电！
自然之道！
也正是因为这样，星罗国的强者掌握了这样的力量之后，被天下人视为真正的天子，天道的代表，甚至影响到了神阙国的人，神阙国才对星罗国发动了战争，神阙就是要证明，在世人眼中这个真正代表天地的国家，也并非那么无敌，唯有他们神阙才是真正的天命所归。
如今再看到大天象诀，他们自然是把李寒舟和星罗国余孽给联系到了一起。
砰！
那无尽的风暴在汇聚到李寒舟手掌中之后，便是当场溃散。
“嗯？”
看到李寒舟手中的风之力溃散了，在场的人又是一愣。
“此人的大天象诀仅仅是修炼个入门？”太玄圣主不禁有些诧异。
大天象诀厉害的地方不仅仅是能将天地之力汇聚，更是能够操控，甚至衍化成各种形态，威力极强，而李寒舟仅仅是将风汇聚过来，暴风图中那般强烈的暴风已经被李寒舟掌控，若是李寒舟出手反击的话，赵千秋此刻的状态怕是根本挡不住。
结果没想到李寒舟竟然将得到手的暴风给散尽了。
足以看出来李寒舟仅仅是修炼到了一点大天象诀的皮毛，根本没修炼的有多么高深。
可是饶是如此，能修炼大天象诀，也足以说明李寒舟不是常人。
然而此时李寒舟的目光却是落到了赵千秋手中的暴风图上，他觉得这个东西不错，这灵宝值得研究研究。

若是能将赵千秋手里的暴风图给抢过来就好了。
“噗。”
就在这个时候，赵千秋又忍不住吐了一口血，刚刚被李寒舟伤了，如今又强行催动暴风图，此刻他的伤势的确是有些重。
赵千秋已经有想要退走的心思了。
因为若是这个时候不走，待会李寒舟又是几道雷符下来，足以将他给轰杀。
虽然心有不甘，但是今天刺杀九皇子的任务已经失败了。
若是不走，自己也要交代在这里。
任务固然重要，但是自己的命更重要。
“我们后会有期。”
赵千秋说完，转身就准备走。
禹青阳上前一步，他看着赵千秋的背影，开口说道：“李先生，此人在我神阙国内杀了很多人，不知道前辈可否出手将此人给留在此地？免得他再出去作恶！”
“对，李前辈，用你那个雷劈死他。”叶紫樱也是赶紧说着。

Ye Ziying and Yu Qingyang couldn't help but take a step back.
Li Hanzhou actually knows the Great Celestial Elephant Technique?
What is his relationship with those people in Yunhuang?
After Li Hanzhou obtained the "Great Celestial Elephant Technique" before, he was also curious about what this technique was like, so when he had nothing to do these days, he also looked through it, but he did not expect that he could actually use it.
After practicing the Great Celestial Elephant Technique to the extreme, you can control the power of celestial phenomena.
Storm, thunder and lightning!
The way of nature!
It is precisely because of this that after the strong men of the Star Luo Kingdom mastered such power, they were regarded by the people of the world as the true emperor and the representative of heaven, and even influenced the people of the Shenque Kingdom. The Shenque Kingdom launched a war against the Star Luo Kingdom. The Shenque Kingdom wanted to prove that in the eyes of the world, this country that truly represents heaven and earth is not so invincible. Only their Shenque Kingdom is the true destination of destiny.
Now that they saw the Great Celestial Elephant Jue again, they naturally connected Li Hanzhou with the remnants of the Star Luo Kingdom.
Bang!
After the endless storm gathered in Li Hanzhou's palm, it collapsed on the spot.
"Huh?"
Seeing that the power of wind in Li Hanzhou's hand collapsed, everyone present was stunned again.
"This person's Great Celestial Elephant Technique is just an introduction to practice?" Saint Master Taixuan couldn't help but be a little surprised.
The powerful thing about the Great Sky Elephant Technique is that it can not only gather the power of heaven and earth, but also control it and even evolve it into various forms. It is extremely powerful. However, Li Hanzhou only gathered the wind. The strong storm in the storm diagram has been controlled by Li Hanzhou. If Li Hanzhou counterattacked, Zhao Qianqiu would not be able to stop it at this moment.
Unexpectedly, Li Hanzhou actually dispersed the storm he got.
It is enough to see that Li Hanzhou has only practiced a little bit of the Great Celestial Elephant Technique, and has not mastered it at all.
But even so, being able to practice the Great Celestial Elephant Technique is enough to show that Li Hanzhou is not an ordinary person.
However, at this time, Li Hanzhou's eyes fell on the storm map in Zhao Qianqiu's hand. He felt that this thing was good and this spiritual treasure was worth studying.
It would be great if the storm map in Zhao Qianqiu's hand could be snatched away.
"Pfft."
At this moment, Zhao Qianqiu couldn't help but spit out a mouthful of blood. He had just been injured by Li Hanzhou, and now he was forcefully activating the storm map. His injury was indeed a bit serious at this moment.
Zhao Qianqiu already had the intention of retreating.
Because if he didn't leave at this time, Li Hanzhou would rain down several thunder talismans later, which would be enough to kill him.
Although he was unwilling to do so, today's mission to assassinate the Ninth Prince had failed.
If you don't leave, you will have to explain yourself here.
The mission is important, but your own life is more important.
"We'll see you later."
After Zhao Qianqiu finished speaking, he turned around and prepared to leave.
Yu Qingyang took a step forward. He looked at Zhao Qianqiu's back and said, "Mr. Li, this person has killed many people in our Shenque Kingdom. I wonder if senior can take action to keep this person here? To prevent him from doing evil again!"
"Yes, Senior Li, use your thunder to kill him." Ye Ziying also said quickly.
